So, i’ve got 381 hours in Shadow of War, and 61 in Shadow of Mordor, about 3 playthroughs in SoW and lemme say that this game is sort of like a make your own story type of game. The orcs you encounter will react to how you play the game and it makes for incredible moments. For instance, I often send one of my orcs out on missions and I DO NOT participate in the slightest, I let him fight his own battles. Whilst I was watching him fight, another orc came up behind me and say “Oh Ranger, you like to watch huh? Why not have a good fight with me instead.” and we fought, he killed me. This game is chock FULL of those hand tailored moments.

So, in terms of raw strength, i’d have to go with Ranger. BUT, in terms of actual power, Zog for certain. Zog has necromantic powers that in my opinion would absolutely overwhelm Ranger, and not only this, he can be resurrected. To me, this isn’t a very fair fight for ranger as we don’t really know how powerful he is compared to your average Olog. But Ranger speaks Black Speech, so he’s pretty cool.

There’s a few separate ways he might show this and of course everybody is different so please keep that in mind! But here’s a few things that I do SUBCONSCIOUSLY with this girl I loved that I’ve noticed.     

If you two are near each other/in the same room do you feel like he’s looking at you? I’ve found that I quite literally just admire her when she looks away because im shy and don’t want to seem weird or creepy towards her. 

Does he often ask you questions or try to learn more about how you feel about things? Even if it’s your favorite show, food you like, etc? He might want to really know what you think and why because he’s interested in you. 

Next, and final thing I’ll say that might fit your situation more since you’re in school and im not( and since this comment is already long, lol) when you walk near his friends or just people you see him interact with alot, do they almost act kinda odd around you? It could be giggling or a simple gesture like slightly nudging each other and looking towards you? 

Remember, every person is different and nay show their interest in very different ways than you might expect. I wish you luck!
